assumptions: Biallelic sites above the minor-allele count, LD-pruned, scaled as chosen.
limits: Components are axes of variance, not populations; their sign and order are not meaningful beyond the variance explained.
Relatedness and uneven sampling can dominate the leading components.
bio.jane/contract.question: What population structure do these genotypes show in their principal components?

description: Principal components of a call set's genotypes, the population-structure picture: biallelic sites above a minor-allele count, LD-pruned by sliding windows, scaled per site (Patterson, standard or centring) and decomposed; every sample's coordinates with its population, and the variance each component explains (scikit-allel pca). Validated on 1000 Genomes phase 3 APOL1, all 2,504 samples.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

groupBy.description: which column of the sample table groups the samples; empty is its first grouping column.

minMac.description: keep biallelic sites whose REF and first ALT are each seen at least this many times.

populations.description: a sample table: a header row with a `sample` column and one or more grouping columns (tab-separated, as 1000 Genomes' .panel). Samples it does not list belong to no group.

precision.description: float64, or float16: scikit-allel's own path when handed integer genotypes, which rounds the scaled matrix to half precision. Values: float64 (Double precision), float16 (Half precision (as scikit-allel on integer genotypes)).

prune.description: drop sites in LD before the decomposition (locate_unlinked), as scikit-allel's PCA assumes.

pruneSize.description: pruning window, in sites. Only applies when prune is true.

pruneStep.description: sites the pruning window advances. Only applies when prune is true.

pruneThreshold.description: prune the later site of a pair whose Rogers–Huff r² exceeds this. Only applies when prune is true.

scaler.description: per-site scaling before the decomposition: Patterson divides the centred dosage by √(p(1−p)); standard by its standard deviation; center only centres. Values: patterson (Patterson (√(p(1−p)))), standard (Standard deviation), center (Centre only).

vcf.description: the call set as VCF text (a .vcf, or a .vcf.gz already decompressed); every record's GT is read, ploidy 2.

name: genotype_pca

coords.description: one row per sample: sample, its group, and its coordinate on each component

explainedVariance.description: the variance each reported component explains, in the data's own units (the eigenvalues)

explainedVarianceRatio.description: the share of variance each reported component explains

sites.description: how many sites qualified, how many pruning kept, and their positions
